tldr: Pluto in Aquarius: power transforms through networks, technology, and collective structures.
body: With Pluto in Aquarius, deep change works on systems: who holds power, how groups organize, and what technology does to both. The transformation is generational rather than personal.
gift: Structural insight, collective power, and the will to rebuild systems that stopped serving.
challenge: Ideological control, the group swallowing the person, and revolution that reproduces the old power.
note: Composed (planet x sign, dignity-aware); refine from authored material.
